name: scanner
description: Local, profile-driven repository scans (security, performance, accessibility, dead code, test coverage): parallel investigation, adversarial triage, HTML or Markdown report, finding tracking across scans, and guarded remediation — with built-in profiles and optional per-project overlays.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the plugin: en (English), fr (Français), es (Español), de (Deutsch).

scan_mode.title: Scan mode
scan_mode.description: What a scan ends with: report (the report only), fix (fixes on a new branch, no report) or review (the report, then you pick the findings, then fixes on a new branch).

report_format.title: Report format
report_format.description: Format of scan reports: html (self-contained page) or md (Markdown).
